### Program
```java
public class CountingLanterns { private static final Object monitorC = new Object();  private boolean asleep = false; private final Object asleepLock = new Object(); public void tryToSleep() { while (true) { boolean isAsleep; synchronized (asleepLock) { synchronized (monitorC) {  isAsleep = asleep;  } } if (isAsleep) { break; } countSomeSheep(); } } private void countSomeSheep() { System.out.println("Tallying a lantern..."); try { Thread.sleep(100); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } public void setAsleep(boolean value) { synchronized (monitorC) { synchronized (asleepLock) {  this.asleep = value;  } } } public static void main(String[] args) { CountingLanterns traveler = new CountingLanterns(); Thread t1 = new Thread(() -> traveler.tryToSleep()); Thread t2 = new Thread(() -> { try { Thread.sleep(500); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } traveler.setAsleep(true); }); t1.start(); t2.start(); try { t1.join(); t2.join(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } }
```

  "family": "deadlock" | "non_deadlock" | "other",
  "bug_class": "resource_deadlock" | "communication_deadlock" | "data_race" | "order_violation" | "atomicity_violation" | "monitor_misuse" | "no_defect" | "other",

  "accesses": [ {"method": string, "op": "read"|"write"|"lock"|"wait"|"notify"|"join"|"acquire"|"release", "target": string} ],

  "fix_action": "restore_sync_block" | "unify_lock" | "remove_nested_lock" | "reorder_locks" | "single_lock" | "restore_join" | "restore_notify" | "restore_wait_loop" | "restore_release" | "restore_semaphore_permits" | "add_volatile_or_atomic" | "other",

- shared_objects: the shared fields AND the locks, monitors or semaphores involved in the defect. Fields as Class.field, locks/semaphores as the bare variable name, "this" for the instance monitor. For arrays or collections use the field name, not the index expression. Use [] if nothing is shared.
- accesses: every operation that takes part in the defect, one object per operation, in program order per method. Include lock acquisitions (op "lock", target = the lock; a synchronized method or synchronized(this) is target "this"), reads/writes of the shared field, wait/notify (target = the object whose monitor is used), join (target = the thread variable), semaphore acquire/release (target = the semaphore). method is Class.method (no parentheses), using the class that declares the method. Do not list unrelated operations.

- conflict: for a lock cycle give "edges" as [lock_held, lock_requested] per thread and "methods" as the involved methods, field null; for a race give "field" (Class.field) and the two racing methods (the same method twice if both racing accesses are in it), edges []; for lost_signal, monitor_not_held and permit_starvation give the involved methods; if there is no conflict use type "none", edges [], field null, methods [].

- fix_where: the methods (Class.method) where the fix is applied; use Class.<init> for a constructor.

- Copy identifiers exactly as spelled in the program.
- Closed fields must use exactly one value from their list; never invent values and never leave them empty.
- Do not write code and do not rewrite the program.
- If you are unsure, still choose the most likely label.
